title: Fourteen Winters and One Short Label
subtitle: 医学药研 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 医学药研（科学与技术·医学与健康科学）
meta: 主题语境：医学药研（科学与技术·医学与健康科学）　|　核心词汇：drug　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 drug 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my grandfather ① made a drug that no patient in the clinic would have taken, and he said the making was the whole of the winter. The ② drug, meaning the medicine and not the poison, ran fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; a drug, he said, is the only thing in a clinic that is judged by how long it is left untaken.

Every ③ drug in that clinic had the same short label at the side of it, and the ④ drug at the end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A drug, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to take; my grandfather said the taking is the part that fills fourteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the drug was the whole of the story, meaning the poison and not the medicine. The ⑥ drug, meaning the poison and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody talks about and nobody admits; drug, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a medicine and a poison. He said the poison is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ drug had become a line in a pharmacopoeia, and the pharmacopoeia had become an argument about the short label. The ⑧ drug of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in January, was one clinic and fourteen winters of taking; drug, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to take. She said the taking was never mentioned.

The ⑨ drug I remember is the one named in the pharmacopoeia, which was withdrawn in 1978 and is still described as the quietest in the clinic. A ⑩ drug, my grandmother said in 1980, is the only one that improves by being taken; every drug, she said, is a poison that has agreed to look like a medicine. She said the poison was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 药；药物（指那间诊所里配过的那一种）
B. n. 药；药物（指那种药本身，与毒品相对）
C. 固定搭配：make a drug 配制一种药
D. n. 药；药物（指留给孩子们的那一种）
E. n. 药；药物（抽象总称，指一间诊所的用药之事）
F. n. 药；药物（指药典上写到、被列名的那一种）
G. n. 毒品；成瘾物（指故事里人人都谈起却无人承认的那样东西）
H. n. 毒品（抽象总称，指人人都谈起却无人承认的那种东西）

items.q: made a drug that no patient in the clinic would have taken
The drug, meaning the medicine and not the poison
the drug was the whole of the story
the drug had become a line in a pharmacopoeia
The drug of the whole thing
A drug, my grandmother said in 1980

answers.why: make a drug 意为“配制一种药”，1957 年祖父配了一种诊所里没有一位病人肯服的药。
drug 意为“药、药物”，指那种药本身而不是毒品，它经过了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
drug 意为“药、药物”，指那间诊所里的每一种药，每一种旁边都有同一张短短的标签。
drug 意为“药、药物”，指留给孩子们的那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
drug 意为“毒品、成瘾物”，指故事里人人都谈起却无人承认的那样东西，叔叔说这种毒品就是那个故事的全部。
drug 意为“毒品”，指人人都谈起却无人承认的那种东西而不是那种药，是故事里人人都谈起、却无人承认的东西。
drug 意为“药、药物”，指药典上写到、被列名的那一种，到 1966 年这种药成了药典里的一行。
drug 意为“药、药物”，祖父一月写道，整件事的用药之事是一间诊所和十四个冬天的服用。
drug 意为“药、药物”，我记得的是药典上列名的那一种，1978 年被撤下了，至今仍被说成诊所里最安静的一种。
drug 为抽象总称，祖母 1980 年说，一种药是唯一会因为被好好服用而变得更好的东西。
